component.name: TunaOS Media Writer
component.summary: Make a bootable TunaOS USB stick

description.p: Pick the desktop you want, and TunaOS Media Writer builds the TunaOS live system on your computer and writes it to a USB stick. Restart from the stick to try TunaOS and install it.
It uses the same builder as iso.tunaos.org. You can also save the ISO file instead of writing a USB stick, or open a build request exported from the website.
